title: Digital images: arrays, filters and geometric transforms
summary: Pixels, dtypes and their traps (a 16-bit thermal frame wrapped to nonsense), convolution with Gaussian and Sobel kernels, the 2 × 3 affine matrix and a bilinear warp: you write NAVERA Lite's image part, check it against OpenCV, turn a drone photo north-up at the map's scale, and find out how wrong its compass was.
